threats.title: Compromise of Student Account via Phishing / Credential Stuffing
threats.description: An attacker steals or guesses valid credentials for Student, impersonating them to log into process 1.0 Authenticate User and modify course enrollments.
threats.mitigation: Enforce Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), strict password complexity policies, and account lockout rate limiting on login attempts.

threats.title: Unauthorized Administrative Access via Registrar Session Hijacking
threats.description: An attacker hijacks an active session of Registrar Staff to inject arbitrary catalog updates or trigger unauthorized database synchronizations.
threats.mitigation: Enforce short session timeouts, binding session IDs to client TLS fingerprints, and requiring re-authentication before administrative actions.

threats.title: Impersonation of Assigned Advisor
threats.description: An attacker compromises an Advisor account or session to access process 4.0 Approve Overload, fraudulently approving unit overloads for unassigned students.
threats.mitigation: Enforce mandatory MFA for all staff roles and validate server-side that the logged-in advisor is explicitly assigned to the requesting student.

threats.title: Authentication Bypass via Credential Lookups Injection
threats.description: Malicious inputs submitted during login alter the authentication database query executed against D1 Student Records DB, bypassing password validation.
threats.mitigation: Utilize parameterized SQL queries / ORM methods and hash all passwords using Argon2id or bcrypt with salt.

threats.title: Denial of Service via Resource-Intensive Search Queries
threats.description: Unauthenticated users submit wildcards or malformed search queries to 2.0 Search Catalog, overloading 02 Course Catalog DB CPU/RAM.
threats.mitigation: Implement strict request rate limiting per IP/session, query timeouts, and caching mechanisms (e.g., Redis) for frequent search requests.

threats.title: Over-Enrollment via Race Condition in Registration Logic
threats.description: Concurrent Registration request payloads exploit race conditions in 3.0 Register for Course, booking more seats in 03 EnrollmentDB than allowed in 02 Course Catalog DB.
threats.mitigation: Enforce atomic database transactions and row-level locks (SELECT ... FOR UPDATE) during seat availability verification and registration commit.

threats.title: Credentials In-Transit Sniffing (TB: internet to portal)
threats.description: Plaintext login credentials intercepted across the untrusted internet boundary.
threats.mitigation: Enforce HTTPS/TLS 1.3 encryption across all public ingress points.

threats.title: Credentials In-Transit Sniffing (TB: internet to portal)
threats.description: Plaintext login credentials intercepted across the untrusted internet boundary.
threats.mitigation: Enforce HTTPS/TLS 1.3 encryption across all public ingress points.

threats.title: Direct SQL Execution / Unauthorized Read on Student Profile Data
threats.description: Unauthorized queries across the data tier boundary expose sensitive student standing, credentials, and unit loads stored in D1 Student Records DB.
threats.mitigation: Restrict database ingress via network security groups to application processes only; encrypt sensitive data columns at rest using AES-256.

threats.title: Unauthorized Tampering of Course Prerequisites and Seat Capacities
threats.description: An attacker tampers with prerequisite rules or seat caps directly within 02 Course Catalog DB, enabling unauthorized course additions.
threats.mitigation: Restrict database user privileges so the web portal user has read-only access to course catalogs, allowing write permissions only through dedicated admin connections.

threats.title: Enrollment Record Deletion / Repudiation of Transaction History
threats.description: Registration records in 03 EnrollmentDB are deleted or overwritten without maintaining immutable audit logs, preventing verification of student actions.
threats.mitigation: Implement append-only transaction logging with cryptographic hashes for all add, drop, and overload records in 03 EnrollmentDB.

threats.title: Sync Process Manipulation / Denial of Service
threats.description: Repeated execution of Trigger Sync exhausts database connection pools between 5.0 Sync to SIS, 03 EnrollmentDB, and Legacy SIS.
threats.mitigation: Queue sync requests asynchronously via a broker (e.g., RabbitMQ) with rate limiting, preventing concurrent redundant sync execution.

threats.title: Unassigned Student Overload Approval (Privilege Escalation)
threats.description: An authenticated advisor manipulates request parameters in 4.0 Approve Overload to approve unit overload requests for students outside their assigned domain.
threats.mitigation: Implement fine-grained, object-level access controls (ABAC) to verify advisor-student assignment mapping before modifying records.

threats.title: Rogue Legacy System Impersonation
threats.description: An unauthorized rogue server impersonates Legacy SIS to send forged acknowledgments back to process 5.0 Sync to SIS.
threats.mitigation: Enforce Mutual TLS (mTLS) with static IP whitelisting between the portal sync connector and Legacy SIS.
